This aggressive enhancement pattern is a hallmark of astrocytic lineage tumors, particularly high-grade ones, making a 1p/19q co-deletion highly unlikely. overall_comment: The combination of marked, thick-rim enhancement and extensive surrounding edema, despite the small tumor size, is highly characteristic of a Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype.
